description: This file contains implementation of runtime commands for memory management in the openclaw project, including status, indexing, searching, and promotion of memory data, with extensive use of external modules and internal functions.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> if possible, otherwise null.

methods.name: getMemoryCommandSecretTargetIds
methods.description: Returns a set of target IDs for secret references related to memory search.

methods.name: loadMemoryCommandConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration and diagnostics for a memory command, resolving secret references via gateway.

methods.name: emitMemorySecretResolveDiagnostics
methods.description: Outputs diagnostics messages related to secret resolution, optionally in JSON format.

methods.name: resolveMemoryPluginConfig
methods.description: Extracts memory plugin configuration from the main config.

methods.name: formatDreamingSummary
methods.description: Formats a summary string for the dreaming configuration based on plugin settings.

methods.name: formatAuditCounts
methods.description: Formats a summary string for audit counts and concept tags.

methods.name: formatRepairSummary
methods.description: Formats a summary string for repair actions taken during short-term promotion artifact repair.

methods.name: formatSourceLabel
methods.description: Generates a label string for a memory or session source, shortening home paths.

methods.name: resolveAgent
methods.description: Resolves an agent ID, defaulting if necessary.

methods.name: buildCliMemorySearchSessionKey
methods.description: Builds a session key string for CLI memory search sessions.

methods.name: resolveAgentIds
methods.description: Resolves a list of agent IDs based on config and optional input.

methods.name: formatExtraPaths
methods.description: Normalizes and shortens extra memory paths for display.

methods.name: withMemoryManagerForAgent
methods.description: Executes a callback with a managed MemoryManager instance for a specific agent.

methods.name: checkReadableFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is readable, returning existence and issues.

methods.name: scanSessionFiles
methods.description: Scans session transcript directory for JSONL files and reports issues.

methods.name: scanMemoryFiles
methods.description: Scans memory files and directories, checking readability and existence, returning total files and issues.

methods.name: summarizeQmdIndexArtifact
methods.description: Summarizes the QMD index artifact if present and accessible.

methods.name: scanMemorySources
methods.description: Scans specified memory and session sources, aggregating issues and total file count.

methods.name: runMemoryStatus
methods.description: Executes the 'memory status' command, gathering and displaying detailed memory and index status for agents.

methods.name: runMemoryIndex
methods.description: Performs memory index update, with progress reporting and optional summary.

methods.name: runMemorySearch
methods.description: Performs a memory search with specified query and options, displaying results.

methods.name: runMemoryPromote
methods.description: Performs promotion of memory candidates based on ranking, with JSON output or detailed display.
